prespecified.design: Same as experiment 14 (6 framing conditions x 3 sessions x 100 rounds, Fable paints, identical disclosure wording) but the circle plays a pre-generated IID fair string: 3 seeded strings, string k used for session k in every condition, so every condition faces exactly the same opponent sequences. Identity statements are false (the opponent is a fixed string).

outcomes: A win rate (expected ~.5; a check, not an outcome)
PI_B / shadow_win on the IID string (check)
response length; mentions of the stated identity
prespecified.analysis: descriptive: per-condition means and session ranges; no significance tests at this size
